<div class="card-body">
'''LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4039). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="photograph">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-premiere-japanese/imagegallery/724984 PSA collector gallery]; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/197026802/3nuThsjW2UGb0DlnFR0hZQ.jpg original Japanese card photograph].</ref>

'''Incomplete documentation:''' Rule-derived attributes and card relationships have not yet been verified. Comparison with the English printing has not yet been reviewed.

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8K（エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ）</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このＬＩＮ－Ｖ８Ｋはジャワに再改造されたもの。</span><ref name="photograph" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''English reading aid (AI translation)'''

'''Lore:''' A typical armored droid for laying mines and demolition, adapted for military use. It lays and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K has been modified again by Jawas.<ref name="photograph" />

'''Game text:''' Can lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to ‘disable’ (lose) one mine at the same location card.<ref name="photograph" />
